other_conditions: Applicant must be the nominee or legal heir of the deceased worker
Deceased worker must have been registered with the Jammu and Kashmir Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Deceased worker must have been an active member of the Board at the time of death
Scheme can be applied for only once
benefits_summary: Provides a one-time funeral assistance of ₹5,000 to the nominee or legal heir of a deceased registered worker.
